LESSON: USING OUR SENSES TO IDENTIFY FOOD

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.3: Using our senses to identify food

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Using our senses to identify food. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Using our senses to identify food
2. Practise Using our senses to identify food at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Using our senses to identify food

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Using our senses to identify food
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Using our senses to identify food. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Using our senses to identify food at school and at home

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Using our senses to identify food

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Using our senses to identify food using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Using our senses to identify food in the examples.
2. Explain Using our senses to identify food to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Using our senses to identify food.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

2. Answer: Why is Using our senses to identify food important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
